name: Plach v pustote
source:
Eloise finds herself in a mysterious other world.
She must face its dangers and inhabitants while carrying the pain of all she has endured.

[From [url=https://sanrin-games.itch.io/weeping-in-the-void]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
埃洛伊丝发现自己身处一个神秘莫测的异世界。
背负着过往所承受的一切伤痛，她必须直面这个世界的重重危机与形形色色的住民。

[摘自[url=https://sanrin-games.itch.io/weeping-in-the-void]itch.io[/url]]
